verdict.rationale: AI inbox triage is a fair question for an email service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI-driven auto-labeling, categorization, or attention-surfacing. Filters & Rules, spam filtering, and snooze are user-configured or adjacent features, not AI triage, and JMAP API access is only a developer building block someone could use to build such a system.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
